install: set -euo pipefail; VENV="$HOME/.venvs/pyaegean"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$VENV")"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ -x "$VENV/bin/python" ] || uv venv --seed --python python3 "$VENV"; uv pip install --python "$VENV/bin/python" -e ".[dev,all,docs,parquet]" pytest-xdist; else [ -x "$VENV/bin/python" ] || python3 -m venv "$VENV"; "$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install --no-input -e ".[dev,all,docs,parquet]" pytest-xdist; fi; "$VENV/bin/python" -m ipykernel install --user --name python3; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF "export VIRTUAL_ENV=\"$VENV\"" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "export VIRTUAL_ENV=\"$VENV\"" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF "export PATH=\"$VENV/bin:\$PATH\"" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "export PATH=\"$VENV/bin:\$PATH\"" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
